headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (ENXTAM:CCEP) Stock May Be Reasonable As Cash Flow Supports It
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners has delivered a powerful share price run in recent years, which puts a spotlight on whether the current market value is still grounded in the cash it can generate. After such a strong stretch, the question is how well that price now lines up with the stream of cash flows the business is expected to produce. Over the past 5 years, Coca-Cola Europacific Partners has returned 175.

headlines.title: What Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (NASDAQ:CCEP) reported third-quarter revenue growth of 5.8% on a comparable, foreign-exchange-neutral basis, supported by a 3.6% increase in volume and improved revenue per unit case.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Exceeds Q3 Revenue Expectations as Volumes Rise, Maintains Full-Year Guidance
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (NASDAQ:CCEP) reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter trading, supported by higher beverage volumes and revenue growth across its European and Asia Pacific operations. The bottling group maintained its full-year guidance despite exceeding analyst forecasts on several key performance measures.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners beats Q3 revenue forecasts, guidance unchanged
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Coca-Cola Europacific Partners reported third-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, with organic revenue growth of 5.8% compared to the consensus estimate of 4.7%. The company maintained its full-year guidance.

description: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC, together with its subsidiaries, produces, distributes, and sells a range of non-alcoholic ready-to-drink beverages. It offers flavours, mixers, energy drinks, soft drinks, water, enhanced water, isotonic drinks, tea and coffee, juices, and other drinks. The company provides its products under the Coca-Cola Original Taste, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Diet Coke, Sprite, Sprite Zero Sugar, Fanta, Fanta Zero Sugar, Monster Energy, A&W, Absolut Vodka & SPRITE, Ades, Appletiser, aquaBona, Aquarius, BACARDÍ Mixed with Coca Cola RTD, Barista Bros, Bonaqua, BURN, Deep Spring, Dr Pepper, Dr Pepper Zero Sugar, Feral Brewing Co, Fuze Tea, Giancarlo Coffee, GLACEAU smartwater, Grinders, HALO, Jack Daniel's & Coca-Cola ready-to-drink, Kristal, L&P, MER, Minute Maid, Mother, Mount Franklin, Nordic Mist, Nutriboost, Oasis, Pulpy, pump, pumped, Reign, Rekorderlig Cider, Relentless, Royal, Royal Bliss, Schweppes, Schweppes Mix, SOCO, URGE, Vilas del Turbón, Voyage, Wilkins Pure, and Zephyr Coffee Co brands. It is also involved in the bottling and other operations. The company was formerly known as Coca-Cola European Partners plc and changed its name to Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC in May 2021. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Uxbridge, United Kingdom.
